bank.conditional_mean: unchanged v78 local linear ridge residual prediction
bank.covariance_estimator: OAS second moment of local reference leave-one-out prediction errors
bank.leave_one_out: fixed 64-neighbor set and alpha; hold each reference row out of the local residual fit
bank.likelihood_units: physical delta-state Gaussian density including log determinant

reference_metadata.transition_prior: (1-h)*previous posterior + h/5; uniform redraw including same mode
reference_metadata.mode_weights: recursive finite-mode posterior from untempered transition log densities
reference_metadata.history_reset: independent trajectory only; persists across episode reset
reference_metadata.departure_signal: softplus(log(mean changed posterior mass / normal posterior mass)); not a Bayes factor

limitations: Development replays, one source training seed and mild known modes; not RL return evidence.
Local reference leave-one-out errors do not measure query extrapolation error; no query-leverage inflation is applied.
OAS estimates the zero-centered prediction-error second moment without bias recentering.
The five baseline statistics are reused from v78, not independent replications.
